t.Quasi nessuno cerca casa su Instagram. E: Almost nobody looks for a home on Instagram. Yet that's where many people discover they want a new one: in the evening, scrolling between a friend's video and a recipe. For a development that still needs to get noticed, that moment is worth a lot.
t.Perché Meta conta così tanto nel residen: Why does Meta matter so much in new residential?
t.Chi compra una casa in costruzione spess: People buying a home under construction often aren't looking yet. They have a vague idea: more space, a terrace, a better energy class, lower bills. They don't type anything into Google until that idea becomes a plan. Facebook and Instagram get there first. They show the right render to the right person, in the right area, and turn a hazy wish into a concrete question: how much is a 3-room flat there?
t.Per uno sviluppatore significa riempire: For a developer, this means filling the top of the funnel. Letting people know the project exists: those who live or work a few kilometres away, those whose age and family situation make it relevant, those who have already visited the website without leaving their number.
t.Cosa funziona in un annuncio immobiliare: What works in a real estate ad on Instagram?
t.Le immagini contano più di qualsiasi tes: Images matter more than any text. A well-crafted render of the living area, a readable floor plan, a short video of the site taking shape. People stop for what they can imagine living in. The text answers the questions that come right after: where, when, starting from how much.
t.Funzionano bene anche i formati che acco: Formats that guide people along also work well: a carousel that moves from the neighbourhood to the apartment, a story with the delivery date, a form that asks only what's needed to call back. Every extra field in the form cuts enquiries, every field removed lowers quality. Finding the balance is half the job.
t.Come si evita di pagare contatti che non: How do you avoid paying for leads that never buy?
t.Il limite di Meta lo conosce chiunque l': Anyone who has used Meta knows its limit: lots of names, few visits. It happens when a campaign is judged on cost per lead alone. The system learns to find people who fill in forms, which is not the same as finding people who buy homes.
t.La strada più solida è collegare le camp: The most solid approach is to connect campaigns to what happens next. If the CRM records who was called back, who booked an appointment and who came to the sales office, those signals can be fed back to Meta. The algorithm then optimises for what matters, and budget shifts towards the audience that actually shows up.
t.Meglio Facebook o Instagram per vendere: Facebook or Instagram for selling new apartments?
t.Di solito si usano entrambi, nella stess: Usually both, in the same campaign. Instagram reaches young couples and first-time buyers more easily. Facebook stays strong with people who already own a home to sell and want to move up in size. The system decides the split based on results, and it's worth giving it room.
t.Quanto budget serve per partire?: How much budget do you need to start?
t.Dipende dalla città, dal numero di unità: It depends on the city, the number of units and the stage of the development. Giving a figure without knowing the project would be of little use: in the initial analysis we estimate a media budget in line with the visits you need.
t.Servono i render prima di partire?: Do you need renders before starting?
t.Aiutano molto. Senza immagini degli inte: They help a lot. Without interior images it's hard for someone who has never been to the site to picture the home. If they're missing, they can be produced while the campaigns are being set up.
t.Le campagne Meta prendono il posto dei p: Do Meta campaigns replace the portals?
t.Fanno un lavoro diverso. I portali racco: They do a different job. Portals capture people who are already searching, Meta creates interest among those who aren't searching yet. In a well-built plan the two channels pass the baton to each other.

t.Quando qualcuno scrive «nuove costruzion: When someone types «new developments Parma» or «class A apartments near me», they've already decided something. They're comparing. Google Ads is about being found at that exact moment, with a clear answer at the top of the page.
t.Che ruolo ha Google nel percorso di chi: What role does Google play in the journey of a new-home buyer?
t.È il canale dell'intenzione. Le persone: It's the channel of intent. People arrive with a question in mind: a neighbourhood, a unit type, a price range, sometimes the builder's name. People who saw an ad on Instagram often search for the project on Google afterwards, to check it's serious. That second search is a delicate moment and needs to be covered.
t.Per questo una campagna di ricerca per u: That's why a search campaign for a development almost always has two sides. On one side the local keywords, where you meet people who are weighing options. On the other the searches for the project and company name, where you capture people who have already heard of you.
t.Su quali ricerche ha senso investire?: Which searches are worth investing in?
t.Le ricerche immobiliari sono molto local: Real estate searches are very local and often short. «New 3-room flat Collecchio» brings less traffic than «homes for sale Parma», but whoever types it is much closer to a visit. It pays to start with specific searches, measure them, and broaden only when the numbers justify it.
t.Altrettanto importante è dire a Google c: Just as important is telling Google what to exclude: rentals, auctions, resales, construction job offers. Every click on the wrong search is budget you don't get back.
t.Qui si vince o si perde. Se l'annuncio p: This is where you win or lose. If the ad talks about 3-room flats with terraces and the page opens on a generic gallery, the person leaves. Pages built for that search work: available unit types, prices or price ranges when they can be given, delivery times, a simple way to request a visit.
t.Il salto di qualità arriva quando Google: The real step up comes when Google receives signals back from the CRM. Knowing which searches led to appointments, not just completed forms, changes how budget is spread across keywords.
t.Per un cantiere conviene Google Ads o la: For a development, Google Ads or SEO?
t.Un cantiere ha una finestra di vendita l: A development has a limited sales window, often one or two years. SEO takes months to deliver results, while ads are visible from day one. The SEO basics of the project website should be covered anyway, but the initial push comes from Google Ads.
t.Ha senso fare pubblicità sul nome del pr: Does it make sense to advertise on your own project name?
t.Quasi sempre sì. Costa poco, protegge da: Almost always. It costs little, protects you from portals and competitors buying the same words, and captures the people closest to a decision.
t.Performance Max funziona nell'immobiliar: Does Performance Max work in real estate?
t.Può funzionare, soprattutto quando le co: It can, especially when the conversions imported from the CRM are reliable. Without that data it tends to chase easy volume. We use it carefully, alongside search campaigns.
t.Quanto tempo serve per vedere i primi co: How long until the first leads?
t.Le campagne di ricerca generano traffico: Search campaigns generate traffic as soon as they're approved. Understanding which keywords bring visits takes a few weeks of data, and from there budget starts to shift.

t.Cos'è la GEO e perché riguarda il mercat: What is GEO and why does it matter for real estate?
t.GEO sta per Generative Engine Optimizati: GEO stands for Generative Engine Optimization: the work needed for AI models to know a project, understand it and cite it when relevant. In new residential it matters more than it seems. Home buyers ask a lot of questions before they pick up the phone: neighbourhoods, energy classes, reliable builders, new-build versus renovated. A growing share of those questions goes through an AI assistant.
t.Siamo all'inizio, e nessuno può promette: It's early days, and nobody can promise a fixed spot in a generated answer. But the factors that increase the chances of being cited are fairly clear, and almost all of them depend on how the project website is built.
t.Come decide un'IA quali progetti citare?: How does an AI decide which projects to cite?
t.I modelli leggono il web e preferiscono: Models read the web and favour sources that are clear, consistent and verifiable. A page explaining where the development is, how many units there are, what energy class they have, who's building and when it's delivered is easy to summarise. A page made of images and slogans much less so.
t.Pesa anche quello che dicono gli altri:: What others say matters too: local press articles, portal listings, reviews, mentions on partner and institutional websites. The more consistently the project is described across different places, the more a model treats it as a reliable answer.
t.Cosa si può fare in pratica?: What can you do in practice?
t.Si parte dal sito. Testi scritti per ris: It starts with the website. Copy written to answer buyers' real questions, structured data that describes the project in a machine-readable format, dedicated pages for the neighbourhood, unit types and specifications. Then comes work on the external presence, so the project information stays identical wherever it appears.
t.Infine si misura. Esistono strumenti che: Finally, you measure. There are tools that track how and how often a brand appears in the answers of the main assistants, and visits coming from ChatGPT and similar tools already show up in Analytics. The numbers are still small, but they're growing, and those who start now start ahead.
t.Si appoggia sulla SEO. Molti principi so: It builds on SEO. Many principles are the same: clear content, a fast website, consistent information. What changes is the type of question, longer and more conversational, often with an implicit comparison between options.
t.Si può pagare per comparire nelle rispos: Can you pay to appear in ChatGPT's answers?
t.Le piattaforme stanno introducendo forma: Platforms are introducing ad formats gradually, and differently from country to country. Presence in organic answers remains the foundation, and it's built with content and reputation.
t.Quanto tempo serve per vedere risultati?: How long does it take to see results?
t.Dipende da quanto il progetto è già pres: It depends on how present the project already is online. The first citations usually come after the website has been updated and indexed, and after other sources have started talking about it. It's a matter of months.
t.Ha senso anche per un singolo cantiere?: Does it make sense for a single development too?
t.Sì, se il sito di progetto viene costrui: Yes, if the project website is built well from the start. The extra cost is limited and the same work improves classic SEO and the campaigns' landing pages.
t.Lapis Performance prepara siti e contenu: Lapis Performance prepares project websites and content designed to be read by people and by AI assistants, and monitors when your development appears in the answers. We start with an analysis of how ChatGPT and Google describe your area today.
t.Immobiliare.it, Idealista, Casa.it. Per: Immobiliare.it, Idealista, Casa.it. For people looking for a home in Italy they're still the most common starting point. People come back several times, save searches, put similar listings side by side. A new project presented badly there loses opportunities every day.
t.Perché i portali restano centrali anche: Why do portals stay central even with social and Google?
t.Perché è lì che le persone fanno i conti: Because that's where people do the maths. On a portal the buyer filters by area, price, square metres and number of rooms, and scrolls through dozens of alternatives in a few minutes. Your new 3-room flat ends up next to the renovated resale on the next street. It's a direct comparison, and it needs preparing.
t.Per chi costruisce i portali hanno anche: For builders, portals also have a practical advantage: they capture demand that's already qualified. Someone writing from a listing knows what they want, has an idea of their budget and usually asks to see the property.
t.Cosa rende più forte un annuncio di nuov: What makes a new-development listing stronger?
t.Le immagini, prima di tutto, nell'ordine: Images, first of all, in the right order: the bright living area first, the building after, the floor plan always there. Then a title that says what sets the project apart and a description that answers questions before they come up: delivery, energy class, running costs, parking, finishes.
t.Conta anche come si organizzano le unità: How the units are organised matters too. Publishing each unit type as its own listing, with its own price and floor plan, helps people filtering by size find the right one. The dedicated new-development pages that many portals offer give extra visibility, at costs to be assessed case by case.
t.Come si misura il valore dei contatti da: How do you measure the value of portal leads?
Many stop at the number of enquiries. It's a useful figure, but it only tells half the story. Portals also generate curious leads who message several listings in the same afternoon. It makes sense to record in the CRM which portal each person comes from and follow them through to the appointment.
t.Con questi dati la scelta dei pacchetti: With this data, choosing paid packages becomes simple: you invest where leads show up at the sales office and cut back where they stay on paper.
t.Quali portali usare per vendere nuove co: Which portals should you use to sell new developments?
t.Immobiliare.it e Idealista coprono gran: Immobiliare.it and Idealista cover most of the demand in many Italian cities. Casa.it and local portals can make sense in specific areas. The choice depends on the city and the type of buyer.
t.Conviene pagare per la visibilità in evi: Is it worth paying for featured visibility?
t.A volte sì, soprattutto nelle prime sett: Sometimes, especially in the first weeks of a launch or for unit types that move more slowly. The decision is made by looking at how many visits the leads bring, together with the cost of the package.
t.Chi risponde ai contatti che arrivano da: Who answers the leads coming from portals?
t.Di norma il team commerciale o l'agenzia: Usually the sales team or the appointed agency. We handle listings, tracking and reporting, and help define response times and approach: how fast the first call-back happens strongly affects how many people reach a visit.

t.Vendere una casa che non c'è ancora chie: Selling a home that doesn't exist yet takes an act of trust. The buyer has to imagine the light in the living room, the view from the balcony, the walk from home to school. Renders and landing pages are the tools that make that imagining easy.
t.Perché i render contano così tanto nella: Why do renders matter so much when selling off-plan?
t.Perché fanno le veci della visita. Nelle: Because they stand in for the visit. In the early stages of construction there's nothing to show, and even the best salesperson struggles to describe an apartment from a floor plan. A photorealistic render puts the person inside the room. The same images become the material for every channel: Meta ads, portal listings, brochures, site hoardings.
t.I render migliori rispondono alle domand: The best renders answer buyers' questions: what the light is like in mid-afternoon, how big the terrace is compared to a table for six, what you see from the window. A precise, honest image works better than a spectacular but generic one.
t.Cosa deve fare una landing page di proge: What should a project landing page do?
t.Deve raccogliere l'interesse generato da: It should capture the interest generated by the campaigns and turn it into a visit request. People arrive from an ad with a question in mind, and the page needs to answer within seconds: where it is, which unit types there are, when it's delivered, the starting price or how to find out.
t.Il modulo merita la stessa cura. Nome, t: The form deserves the same care. Name, phone and unit type of interest are often enough, and every extra question needs a reason. Every submission goes into the CRM with its source, so you always know which campaign generated it.
t.Il sito aziendale racconta l'impresa: st: The company website tells the company's story: history, past developments, way of working. It's for people who want to know whether to trust you. The landing page tells the story of a single project to someone who has just arrived from an ad, and has one goal. Keeping them separate makes it easier to measure and to change copy and images during the campaign without touching anything else.
t.Una pagina costruita bene è anche la bas: A well-built page is also the foundation for organic search and AI assistants. Clear, structured information helps Google and ChatGPT describe the project correctly.
t.Quanti render servono per un lancio?: How many renders do you need for a launch?
t.Dipende dal numero di tipologie. Di soli: It depends on the number of unit types. You usually start with an exterior, the living area of the main unit type, a bedroom and a detail of the terrace or garden. The rest is added when the campaigns need new content.
t.Si possono usare i render del progettist: Can you use the designer's renders?
t.Spesso sì, come base. I render tecnici n: Often, as a starting point. Technical renders are made for approvals and permits. To sell, you need framing, light and furnishing designed for people who have to imagine their own life inside.

t.Con testi e render pronti, poche settima: With copy and renders ready, a few weeks, including form testing and the CRM connection.
